partition: Distinct actor/patient ordered pairs; (actor_index + 2*patient_index + predicate_index) mod 5: 0=evaluation, 1=development, otherwise=train. All four status combinations and both input orders stay together.
scope: 6 fixed names, 4 ichidan verb stems, affirmative/negative x asserted/hypothetical, 2 constructions; single event; mandatory punctuation; hypothetical requires もし and conditional suffix; no は/pronouns/quotes/embedded clauses.
training: Fixed lexicon teaching pairs plus supervised state/action and token-generation traces of train partition only. No original sentences or context-to-action tables saved in inference model.
scoring: Independent bounded grammar implementation, not the learner's own readback. Rates use all held-out examples (abstentions count as misses). Two output goals per example. Reordered subset has a goal different from input order.

stress.interpretation: Separate atomic-memory capacity probe; does not measure language-document capacity. Wrong retrieval/false acceptance must be reported.

limits: no logical inference or live memory updates
no efficiency advantage claim over conventional finite state transducers
